nom: Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Whipped Cream Cleanser

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several, including one describing a dry-winter routine, say the cleanser is surprisingly hydrating and leaves skin dewy rather than tight, while others, including one whose skin is normally 'normal to dry', say it leaves their face feeling slightly dry or, in one case, dry enough that she would not repurchase.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report hydrated, balanced, non-stripped skin and even improved texture, though a couple say their face felt a little drier than usual right after cleansing.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report good tolerance and no irritation thanks to the fragrance-free formula, but one reviewer's skin reacted with red spots that progressed into breakouts after about a week of use, alongside a strong, unpleasant scent unlike what most other reviewers describe.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with dry or combination skin, say the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft and never tight, crediting the hyaluronic acid formula; a minority disagree, describing their skin as slightly dry or drier than usual right after rinsing, and one says it left her skin dry enough that she would not repurchase.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers say the cleanser helped clear up acne or kept their skin free of breakouts, but one reviewer's skin developed red spots that progressed into breakouts after about a week of regular use.
concerns.redness: New redness is rarely reported; the one exception is a reviewer whose skin reacted with red spots after about a week of use, alongside an unusually strong scent she attributes to her particular bottle.

aspects.libelle: Hard to control dispensed amount, runs out fast
Struggles with heavy or waterproof makeup
Pricey for the amount you get

extraits.titre: Fun idea but wasn't for me
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I recently tried the Whipped Cream Cleanser, and my experience was a bit of a mixed bag. The packaging is definitely eye-catching. It looks exactly like a whipped cream can, which honestly made me double-check that I hadn't received the wrong product. The texture is also unique, very much like shaving cream. It comes out thick but spreads smoothly and absorbs into the skin quickly. Unfortunately, the scent was a big drawback for me. I was expecting something light or fragrance-free, but instead it had a strong, almost burnt-plastic smell that made it hard to enjoy using. After a week of applying it to my face, my skin reacted with red spots that eventually turned into breakouts. Overall, while I appreciate the fun packaging and interesting texture, the scent and my skin's reaction make it a no-go for my face. I do think it could work better for someone with dry or combination skin who isn't as sensitive to fragrance.

I LOVE Peter Thomas Roth but I DO NOTlikethis product. It comes out like whip cream and it's hard to get the appropriate amount of product needed. Once product is on my face it's just feels odd and has a funky smell. It does do a good job removing make up but leaves my skin feeling dry after use.

The Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Whipped Cream Cleanser has a fun foam texture while still cleansing the skin. It has a medium thick foam consistency once sprayed, but becomes lighter when you're rinsing it off. My skin does feel clean but slightly dry, though my skin is typically normal to dry. The packaging and foam application makes cleansing fun. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This has a clean scent and it is fairly easy to dispense the product. The whip cream style canister seems a little bit gimmicky and the product did an ok job as a second cleanser after a balm. I have combination skin and post cleanse my face felt a little drier than usual.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the Water Drench Whipped Cream Cleanser by Peter Thomas Roth. The whipped cream idea is both unique and fun, the formula has a nice creamy & fluffy feel to it that I like. It applies on nicely and cleans my skin without making it feel dry or stripping it of natural oils. It takes very little and spreads quite a bit, it's a nice fun cleanser that's light weight and hydrating. After I use it makes my skin feel clean, soft, smooth, and hydrated. The only thing I'm not too fond of is the scent of the cleanser, it has a bit of a chemical smell to it but it isn't overpowering so I don't really mind it. I'm someone with combination skin but I mainly struggle with hydration, this is going to make an awesome addition to my hydrating skincare routine/line up!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Finally! Hydration for dry skin that leaves me feeling dewy! I didn't believe it until I tried it! Most cleanser leave my skin feeling tight but this one is just right. I love that skincare and be fun and effective! Most of all, no scent makes this perfect since I don't like strong smells when washing my face. A little bit goes a long way

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This mousse cleanser is so fluffy and fun! It cleans up all the gunk off your face and doesn't dry you out! I do have pretty sensitive skin so I used this product about every three days and it did an amazing job. It smells great and has helped keep my skin clear and smooth. Love this and highly recommend it. I received it complimentary in exchange of an honest review.
